{{Quote|Hello and welcome to the Bestine Museum. I hope you enjoy your visit.|[[Lilas Dinhint]]|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
The '''Museum of Tatooine''', also known as the '''Bestine Museum''', was a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It prided itself on displaying a full [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] [[Bone/Legends|skull]], its vast and varied collection of [[Painting/Legends|paintings]], as well as sculptures of multi-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Glass/Legends|glass]] made from Tatooine's sand. It was advertised in the [[Tatooine Visitors Bureau]] brochure.

==History==
Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Museum/Legends|museum]] was staffed by the curator [[Lilas Dinhint]], who sold an array of artworks to [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] for 48,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Museum_of_Tatooine_ad.jpg|250px|thumb|An advertisement for the museum]]
This museum and the curator [[Lilas Dinhint]] are part of a quest featured in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. In the game, players speak to Lilas, who instructs the player's to visit [[Artist/Legends|artists]] across [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The players can then decide which artist they like best, and vote on the painting they would like to see showcased in the museum. Voting is held every 28 days, and the winning painting is sold by Lilas as a schematic. This schematic can then be used by the Trader profession, for making the actual painting. In the game, players do not need to vote to purchase the painting.
